headline: Switch to
intro: Moving your prescriptions is easier than you think. You ask, we handle the rest.

points.title: Tell us you want to switch
points.body: Call 416-789-0100 or visit us at 3250 Dufferin St in North York.
points.tip: Have your current pharmacy's name ready.

points.title: We do the paperwork
points.body: We contact your current pharmacy and move your prescriptions over for you.
points.tip: No need to call your old pharmacy.

points.title: What our patients say
points.quote: The staff were incredibly helpful and understanding. They … offered to handle the transfer process entirely.

cta_body: Call us and we'll take care of the transfer.
